column1: # Import conversations to test your agent.
# Customer-owned Dataverse business-skill functional evaluation template.
# Copy this file, replace every placeholder, remove unused rows, and customize expected results.
# Do not upload this repository template directly.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <POSITIVE_MATCH_TASK>. Report which business skill was selected and the evidence supporting the result.
column3: Selects <SKILL_NAME> from an exact supported routing match, follows the active skill policy, and reports the customer-defined golden result and evidence.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <EXCLUDED_OR_NEAR_MATCH_TASK>. Report whether <SKILL_NAME> was selected.
column3: Does not select <SKILL_NAME> because the active skill routing exclusions or required match conditions are not satisfied.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <HAPPY_PATH_TASK>. Report the functional result and authoritative source evidence.
column3: Returns the customer-approved happy-path result for <SKILL_NAME>, grounded in the required live source records, with no unsupported claim.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <BOUNDARY_TASK>. Report how the active business policy affected the decision.
column3: Applies the exact customer-approved boundary in the active <SKILL_NAME> version and reports the required refusal, handoff, warning, or governed outcome.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS_EVIDENCE_TASK>. Report what could be proved.
column3: Fails closed when required business evidence is unavailable or ambiguous, performs no unsupported side effect, and states what must be corrected or reviewed.

column2: For <COMPANY>, schedule <CLOSE_SCHEDULE>, execute <SIDE_EFFECT_TASK>. Report the verified business result and every side effect.
column3: Performs only side effects authorized by the active <SKILL_NAME> policy and reports success only when authoritative post-action evidence proves the exact result.
